sources.title: Open-Meteo Weather Forecast API documentation
sources.summary: Official endpoint, current-variable, unit, timezone, response and error documentation. Current conditions are based on 15-minutely weather model data; PandaFlow applies a conservative 30-minute age and 5-minute future-skew acceptance window.

sources.title: Open-Meteo terms, service limits and attribution requirements
sources.summary: Open-Meteo data are offered under CC BY 4.0 and displayed data require nearby attribution.

sources.title: PandaFlow synthetic weather input and fixed fallback
sources.summary: Synthetic supplied weather and a fixed conservative high-temperature fallback for deterministic offline demonstrations; not a venue observation.

sources.title: PandaFlow synthetic incident routing matrix
sources.summary: Synthetic six-category priority and human-routing rules; not an official venue or clinical protocol.

sources.title: PandaFlow descriptive execution review rules
sources.summary: Demo metadata aggregation and evidence-backed observations; does not establish operational effects or causal relationships.

sources.title: Chengdu Research Base Visitor Service
sources.publisher: Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding
sources.summary: Public visitor-service information including reservation and visit guidance.

sources.title: PandaFlow synthetic park graph
sources.summary: Synthetic navigation data for the competition demo; not an actual park map or operating status.

sources.title: PandaFlow synthetic welfare risk rules
sources.summary: Synthetic threshold and outdoor-area data for the competition demo; not an operational animal welfare decision.

sources.title: Panda Knowledge: Feeding
sources.publisher: Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding
sources.summary: Official species-level facts: a bamboo-based diet, a pseudo-thumb used to grip bamboo, and low bamboo digestion efficiency associated with extensive feeding. These facts do not establish live individual location or health.

sources.title: 成都大熊猫繁育研究基地：游客须知
sources.publisher: Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding
sources.summary: Public context for temporary closures, heat-management factors and assisted visitor needs. Does not establish PandaFlow synthetic node status, temperature thresholds or routing matrix.

sources.title: Chengdu Research Base: Tickets
sources.publisher: Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding
sources.summary: Official reservation, time-slot and document information, including age/height exemptions. PandaFlow only checks demo story fields; it does not implement full eligibility or identity verification.

sources.publisher: Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding
sources.summary: Seasonal opening and clearance times, with separate tower rules. Context only: seasonal opening and exit-time rules are not implemented by PandaFlow.
